run.title: Plan 02 — steme audit Walking Skeleton (phax run)

commit.subject: feat(steme): scaffold the apps/steme CLI app skeleton
commit.body:
Create apps/steme as a node-runnable workspace app: @steme-lab/steme, ESM,
per-project scripts (typecheck via plain tsc), a typecheck-only leaf tsconfig
(noEmit + allowImportingTsExtensions so Node 24 runs the .ts source directly),
Vitest config, a steme.package.json declaring the CLI scope set
(cli/core/contracts/adapters/utils), and placeholder scope barrels. No audit
logic yet.

commit.subject: feat(steme): add declarative rule model with strict rulepack validation
commit.body:
Pure-core rulepack parsing for the forbidScopeImport rule type: required fields
only (id, title, type, fromScope, forbiddenScopes, skill), with unknown types,
missing fields, extra fields, and non-canonical scope keys rejected as config
errors naming the rule and field. Runtime inference (importGraph capability,
scope-import-edge fingerprint strategy, error signal) is derived from the type.
Fully unit-tested; no I/O.

phases.title: Rule model, rulepack parsing, strict validation, inference

commit.subject: feat(steme): build the Oxc import graph and hardcoded scope map
commit.body:
Adapter walking one app's src/, parsing with oxc-parser, and emitting a typed
import graph: value, type-only, and literal-dynamic edges, each with its source
line; relative specifiers resolved (including the repo's .js-to-.ts rewrite),
bare and unresolvable specifiers kept as external. Pure-core scope map mirroring
the 12 canonical scope globs with a minimal matcher. Integration-tested against
a generated fixture app.

phases.title: Oxc import graph over one app, hardcoded scope map

commit.subject: feat(steme): evaluate scope-boundary rules into complete diagnostics
commit.body:
Pure evaluation of forbidScopeImport rules over the import graph: internal edges
from the rule's fromScope into any forbidden scope become violations (type-only
and literal-dynamic edges included; unmapped and external files excluded). Each
violation yields a nine-field diagnostic (rule, concept=protected scope,
severity, file, line, problem, why, fix, skill) and the run aggregates into the
AuditReport JSON contract. Unit-tested from hand-built graphs.

commit.subject: feat(steme): wire the steme audit CLI with rulepack, skill and exit contract
commit.body:
Runnable audit chain: rulepacks/boundaries ships TS_BOUNDARY_001 (core must not
import web) with its prose skill; the CLI loads and strictly validates the pack,
preflights skill resolution, builds the import graph over the target app,
evaluates, and renders human or --json output. Exit contract: 0 clean, 1
violations, 2 cannot-run, with 2 never masquerading as 1. Smoke-tested end to
end against apps/sandbox.

phases.title: The `steme audit` command, rulepack artifact, exit contract

commit.subject: test(steme): add the seeded-violation E2E harness for steme audit
commit.body:
End-to-end acceptance harness proving detect → diagnose → explain → repair →
verify: a core → web import seeded into a disposable copy of apps/sandbox is
flagged with a complete, skill-linked diagnostic and exit 1; removing it yields
exit 0; JSON and human outputs agree; type-only imports are flagged; unmapped
files are out of surface; and the committed tree audits clean.

phases.title: Seeded-violation harness: seed → flag → fix → pass
